arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «السِّوَاكُ مَطْهَرَةٌ لِلْفَمِ، مَرْضَاةٌ لِلرَّبِّ».

id.text: Aisyah -raḍiyallāhu 'anhā- meriwayatkan, ia berkata, Rasulullah ﷺ bersabda, "Siwāk itu membersihkan mulut dan mendatangkan keridaan Rabb."

en.text: ‘Ā’ishah (may Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "The tooth-stick purifies the mouth and pleases the Lord."

ms.text: Daripada Aisyah RA, beliau berkata: Rasulullah ﷺ bersabda: “Bersugi itu menyucikan mulut, dan mendatangkan keredaan Tuhan.”

fr.text: 'Âichah (qu'Allah l'agrée) relate : "Le Messager d'Allah (qu'Allah le couvre d'éloges et le préserve) a dit : "Le siwâk est une purification pour la bouche et une satisfaction du Seigneur. "

es.text: 'Aisha —que Al-lah esté complacido con ella— narró haber oído decir al Profeta —que la paz y las bendiciones de Al-láh sean con él—: «El "miswak" higieniza la boca y complace al Señor».

published_matn.scope: Published Arabic narration and its five unchanged publisher translations; without the complete transmission chain.

verification.method: The Arabic record itself is the current HadeethEnc narration, not a match to a different complete-isnad edition. Every translation declares the exact same Arabic text and revision.
verification.internal_decimal_id: The decimal suffix is a publisher record identifier and is not a hadith citation number. Display uses arabicnumber, the source-cited book number.
